paper_name: Direct Tax Laws and International Taxation
author: Rahul kp
title: Place of Effective
simple_words: A foreign company becomes an Indian resident if its real decision-making sits in India.

definitions.meaning: A company is resident in India in a previous year if it is an Indian company, or its POEM in that year is in India.
definitions.note: Test it for each previous year

definitions.meaning: Place where key management and commercial decisions needed to run the business as a whole are, in substance, actually made.

key_points: An ==Indian company== is always resident in India, wherever it is managed.
A ==foreign company== is resident only if its POEM is in India in that year.
POEM is decided on facts and substance, not on the paperwork.
!!Place of incorporation does not decide residence of a foreign company!!

insight.text: POEM is a test only for foreign companies; an Indian company never needs it.

trick_hook: remember the brain, not the body

memory_trick.explanation: Look for the brain taking key decisions, not the registered address or the place of the meeting room. Brain in India means resident.

steps: Is it an Indian company? Then resident
If foreign, find who takes key decisions
Locate where they are made in substance
POEM in India: resident, else not
exam_tip: In MCQs, first check Indian or foreign company. Only for a foreign company, read the facts for where key decisions are really made.

doubt.question: Does a board meeting held in India make POEM India?
doubt.answer: Not by itself. Meeting place is only one fact. If key decisions are in substance made elsewhere, POEM is elsewhere.

mistakes_hook: don't fall for the address trap

mistakes.wrong: Foreign company incorporated abroad is always non-resident
mistakes.right: It is resident in India if its POEM is in India in that previous year.

mistakes.wrong: Indian company with POEM abroad is non-resident
mistakes.right: An Indian company is always resident in India; POEM is not tested for it.

mistakes.wrong: POEM is where the registered office is
mistakes.right: POEM is where key management and commercial decisions are in substance made.

mistakes.wrong: Board meeting place alone fixes POEM
mistakes.right: It is a factor only; the decision is based on substance of the facts.

applicability: Income-tax Act, 1961, A.Y. 2026-27; residence of company
